result.summary: zig build test-integration-plc failed at compile stage. All 4 PLC test files (PLC-01..04) report `cast discards const qualifier` errors (27 total) because `const catalog = ProcessModuleCatalog.init(...)` binds a value-typed `*const ProcessModuleCatalog` while `registerModule` and `publishModule` are declared `self: *ProcessModuleCatalog` (mutable). Production source under src/repository/process_module_catalog.zig is correct. Defect is in test files (TEST-DESIGNER carryover from commit 37c64888). Fix: replace `const catalog = ...` with `var catalog = ...` in all four PLC test files. Backend services + test-env-verify all green; failure is purely compile-stage.

issues.description: `const catalog = ProcessModuleCatalog.init(...)` at line 118 makes `catalog` a value-typed `*const ProcessModuleCatalog`. Calls to `catalog.registerModule(...)` therefore pass `*const T` where the production API requires `*T`. 8 compile errors at lines 134, 178, 213, 236, 271, 320, 365, 417.
issues.fix: Change `const catalog = ProcessModuleCatalog.init(alloc, &pool);` to `var catalog = ProcessModuleCatalog.init(alloc, &pool);`
